notes.title: Quest Log Update for 6/30/2024!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! Today's minor update implements the Quest Log into the game! This is how it is implemented:

[u][b]For new players:[/b][/u]

When starting a new game, the quest will automatically be in your inventory once you gain control of the characters after the opening. 

[u][b]For current players:[/b][/u]

There are checkpoints in the story that will place the Quest Log in your inventory. When you have reached one of the checkpoints, a message, accompanied by a chime, will display on the screen to let you know that you have received the Quest Log.


To use the Quest Log, simply go into your items from the menu, select the Field Items tab, then use the Quest Log item. Once used, a message will display on the screen, telling you what your current objective is.


[u][b]Other things included with this update:[/b][/u]

Some bug fixes and error adjustments
Melrose has been slightly buffed - the website will be updated to reflect this
Changes to the music have been made. Some of the music now have a more seamless loop to prevent some of the music from fading out during gameplay. Note that some songs were unchanged due to the song being fine as is. Also, the standard battle music in Tashir has been changed and adjusted to have a seamless loop.


As always, thank you for playing and supporting Short Adventure! I am working on the next major update, which I hope to have out by the end of the summer. We're getting closer to the end and I am grateful for all of those that have been here along the way. See you in the next update!

- supernerdyguy

notes.title: Version 2.4 / Chapter 9 Update for 6/2/2025!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Short Adventure!

This is version 2.4. When you reach the main menu of the game, ensure that version 2.4 is listed at the bottom of the screen.

The update pushes the game file size to 6GB. Ensure you have the allotted space to update the game.

Here's what to expect in this update!

[u][b]Chapter 9![/b][/u]

Follow Isabella as she takes her team around Iysta, Aldoria, and Talmar, to unravel the mysteries and secrets of the Royal Families in Iysta and Aldoria as it pertains to the strange beast that she and her group encountered in the woods! Whose side is she on? Who can she trust? Does it really pay off to be loyal? What is she willing to do to accomplish her objective? All these, and more, will  be answered!

Princess Melrose, Shara, and Escarlata are still chatting in an Alhest hotel in Tashir when an emergency strikes Trinity via breaking news on TV! Melrose is shaken to the core as she leads the group back to her home to prevent a possible disaster! Will she and the others make it in time? Or will there be a serious tragedy in the making?

A returning character and a brand new character will take the stage and travel to three different countries as they put aside their differences to work together to achieve their objective. Just how well will they get along? Who else will they meet along the way? What has changed around the realm during their travels?


[u][b]New areas![/b][/u]

While I will not spoil there here, there are new areas for you to explore in this update! You will encounter them along your journey through the story!


[u][b]Balancing![/b][/u]

There have been more adjustments to a few characters regarding their moves and abilities to make them more consistent when in battle.

Certain boss behaviors have been changed to relax the difficulty based on feedback. 

A few bosses have had a minor nerf in their stats to ease the difficulty for casual players and to prevent a near endless battle situation in extreme cases.


[u][b]Bug Fixes![/b][/u]

As always, I strive to put the best game out there and have cleaned up several issues that I have found or were reported to me. I thank you all that have reached out to me and let me know when you found something. Please continue to do!


[u][b]Quality of life![/b][/u]

You will notice at game start up that there is a new splash screen! This is to help provide a short summary of information and notes about the updates that were made. This can be skipped with the press of a button.

Certain battle animations were changed and/or adjusted for a smoother battle experience.


[u][b]Future update![/b][/u]

I have a few things planned:

I will be adjusting Risa to make her less complicated to use.

I will be adjusting Jessie to have her preform a bit smoother in battle.

The next update I am planning to make it very large and get closer to the end of the story. With that said, the next update will have you able to obtain the entire party as well as begin optional sidequests as you prepare for the end of the game and the point of no return.
This will probably happen towards the end of the summer, but I will work to get it out sooner.

I am also working on adjusting the UI for the game. I have done testing in the background, and came up with something nice, but...it breaks the game and makes it unplayable. Another UI I came up with created other issues that are not acceptable:
 - character losing HP when attacking despite it being a normal attack and not under a special effect.
 - players unable to input commands for characters while other characters/enemies are preforming their actions

I will continue to work on this to make Short Adventure even better.


[u][b]Closing[/b][/u]

As always, thank you all for playing Short Adventure! We're closing in on a year since the game first released! The game has come a very long way and has undergone many changes. I appreciate all the the players that have tried and the game and have continued to support me along the way! Please contintue to submit all of your feedback and bug reports/errors! I will see you in the next update!

- supernerdyugy

notes.title: 2/18 Update for version 2.3!
notes.content:
After dealing with several internet and power outages (there's been some really windy weather up here), version 2.3 is live! Read the notes below!

[u][b]The completion of Chapter 8![/b][/u]
Follow along and team up with some faces, some new, some familiar, as you dive deeper into what is going on around Avabel! Who can you trust?! Who is really on the side of good?!

[u][b]Animation adjustments![/b][/u]
A follow up to the most recent update, certain animations have been changed and/or adjusted for a better experience in battle!

[b][u]Balancing and bug fixes![/u][/b]
Certain characters have had a few adjustments on their stats and skills to prevent some characters from being too weak or being too powerful! Also, the usual clean up of any errors and issues that were found through testing and gameplay!

[u][b]New skills introduced![/b][/u]
They won't be spoiled here, but play and discover the new abilities introduced in the update for more exciting battles! They also add a new element of strategy!

[u][b]Elemental absorption introduced![/b][/u]
The ability for characters and enemies to absorb an element has finally been added to the game! Certain characters and enemies have had their resistances adjusted to reflect these changes! Try to discover them all as a new strategic element of battle has been added!

As always, thank you for playing and supporting Short Adventure. I am planning to have the next update ready by April. If it's sooner than that, great. In the meantime, I will be working on a walkthrough that can be followed on the wiki, as well as adding new info to the wiki page. Make sure to follow the game's twitter, or my twitter, for any updates regarding the game.

- supernerdyguy

notes.title: Version 2.2 Skill Doubling fix
notes.content: There was a previously undiscovered issue where Escarlata's skill set would show all of her skill twice, causing confusion during the battle against Snyder. This is now fixed. If players have passed this part after encountering the error, a second hot fix has been placed in the Ashen Chasms, after the boss battle.

notes.title: Emergency Bug fix
notes.content: Bug fix for an incident that when triggered, would transport players to content not readily playable and could potentially damage save files.

notes.title: 2.2 update for January 26th! Several quality of life updates!
notes.content:
[u][b]Several changes in this quality of life update:[/b][/u]

The game engine has been updated for more stability.

Visual change on the menu screen:
Enjoy the new look of the menu when you open in during gameplay!

An option to equip new weapons/armor when purchased from the shops has been added!

A splash screen now displays when turning on the game!

During battle, when you open a character's skills/magic/etc., the list will appear above the character HP/MP/TP, allowing you to monitor the status of the party while making your decisions!

HP/MP/TP now 'rolls' instead of counting 'instantly' when increasing and decreasing!

A new 'glass break' battle transition before the start of battle!

Battle speed adjustments:
The delay between attacking animations and damage display has been minimized, making for faster moving battles! The battle log also lingers, allowing you to see what happens better during battle!

An option to configure your controller/keyboard has been added to the options menu in game! Configure your control settings to your liking!

An Instant Recovery option has been added to the menu! This allows you to heal the party with the press of a button using the spells of a character in the party! The character selected is based on current MP, MP cost, and spell strength. All chosen for you! If you don't need healing, or don't have a character in the party that can heal, the game will let you know!

For Steam users, the mouse pointer will disappear from the game screen when left idle for 3 seconds. 

A time progress bar has been added to the battle screen! This allows you to see not only when the party members' turns are coming, but also the enemy party's, as well! You are now able to plan your moves with a bit more strategy!

A floating camera has been added! For a bit more immersion, the camera will float over the battlefield and move accordingly depending on who is attacking at the time! Enjoy the angles!

A sound now plays when it is a character's turn to help players know when it is their turn!

The number of hits and total damage in a combo now displays while attacking! Enjoy the new flair added to the battle!

Icons and text now display when someone is afflicted with a status effect or beneficiary of a positive effect! Text will also appear when the status/positive effect is removed/wears off!

Characters will have text appear over them when performing their moves!

Text will now appear and a unique sound will play when a weakness/resistance/critical hit has been achieved!

Various minor bug fixes and error cleanups.

Thank you playing and continuing to support Short Adventure!

notes.title: 12/29 - 2.1 Update! Video removal!
notes.content:
This update was going to be bigger, but I had a power outage during dev work and lost some of the data and all of my patch notes. Thankfully, I had backed up most of the work/game earlier.

Video Removal:
In response to feedback from others, I have removed all of the videos from the game, with the exception of the following: the opening movie when a new game is started, the optional look in the mirror video that plays during chapter 7, the optional dance video that plays during chapter 7. This should remove the problems that players had with viewing the cutscenes on their PCs. This also removes the problem of unable to pause the video if a player has to step away from the game. All of the video cutscenes have been replaced with pictures and in-game text.

Character Adjustments:
Certain characters have had their moves adjusted due to the damage not calculating properly due to the damage type of the move being incorrect. As I mentioned before, my notes were lost in the power outage, so I unfortunately cannot remember EVERY change I made, but I do know that this mainly affects the temporary characters that join the party, as well as the following main party members: Dashell, Jessie, Escarlata.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue in chapter 7 where the screen fades to black and does not come back during a scene in Rolando.
Fixed an issue where the player character could get stuck after speaking with an NPC during chapter 7 in Rolando.
Fixed an issue where the screen fades to black and doesn't come back until after a few lines of text has displayed at the beginning of chapter 6.
Fixed the overall picture flickering issue that plagued much of the initial 2.0 update.
Spelling, grammar, typo, spacing issues that were found are corrected.
Fixed the issues of the pictures not displaying at the proper resolution in game. This was mainly due to the image resizer that I used after creating the images on a different website not being accurate to the images on my PC.
Fixed an issue where the game could improperly play through a cutscene without the player character and/or the npc characters present. Both of these instances occurred in chapter 7.

As always, thank you for playing Short Adventure! I will continue to monitor and test through the game for more issues, as well as continue to develop the rest of the game through its completion. Happy Holidays and Happy New Year!

notes.title: 12/26/2024 - emergency fix
notes.content: Fixed a major issue where menu access was disabled early in the new content. The fix goes in to effect when you enter Melrose's room for the first time or when you exit the secret path in Trinity Mahal.

notes.title: Update for 12/24/2024 - Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[u][b]Happy Holidays and Merry Christmas from me to you (to all that celebrate)![/b][/u]

[u]12/24/2024 Update:[/u]
When you teach the title screen, it should say version 2.0 in the bottom corner.

[b]Chapter 6 conclusion![/b]
The game picks up right where you left off after Escarlata and Melrose took on the Royal Knights of Aldoria - led by Snyder! Now, continue to follow the young ladies as they make their way to Trinity!

[b]Chapter 7![/b]
Take a trip back in time with Shara, as she retells what went on once she came back from the Great Aldoria Mountains!

[b]Chapter 8![/b]
Things start to slowly unravel in Avabel... Follow along and see how it affects many members of the party!

[b]New and updated areas to explore![/b]
Your adventure will take you to new places! Enjoy the sights and sounds around not only Aldoria, but Iysta, Talmar, and Tashir!

[b]Skills and abilities reworked![/b]
At first, every party member had just "Magic" and "Technique". Not anymore! The skills and spells for most party members have been reworked and changed to fit more inline with the type of character they are. For example, a character may have "Sword Art" instead of "Technique". 

[b]Stat Adjustments![/b]
Nearly every party member has had some sort of adjustment to their overall parameters. While most of these changes were small boosts, the most notable changes are Mishiru's and Kasai's base HP. Both have been raised by a significant amount.

[b]New skills added![/b]
There are new skills added that characters will learn mainly through progress but, there are some that will have be discovered, which brings me to my next point...
(About Esmeralda: She has been given the skill Driven. If you have already played as her, this skill will be added once she returns to the party. If you have not played as her, you will have this skill when she first joins the party.)

[b]Side Quests![/b]
There are several sides quests added in this update that contain extremely valuable rewards! While they are not necessary to progress in the game, I have made them worth your time if you decide to do them! So, don't be afraid to take a detour here and there!

[b]Equipment Adjustments![/b]
The equipment has been adjusted in ways to allow players more flexibility in what to use for the party members they have.
General Armor/Helms are strong and has not been adjusted.
Small Shields now have a hidden evasion boost that goes into effect immediate in battle.
Heavy Armor/Helms/Shields now have a hidden HP boost that will display when selected.
Light Armor/Helms now have a hidden speed boost that will display when selected, as well as a hidden evasion boost that does not display but goes into effect immediately in battle.
Magical Armor now have a hidden magic defense and MP boost that will display when selected as well as a small boost to MP regen that goes into effect immediately in battle.
Magical Helms now have a hidden magic attack/defense boost that will display when selected as well as a small boost to magical damage that goes into effect immediately in battle.
Bangles now have a hidden spirit and agility boost that will display when selected.
Arm Guards have a hidden HP boost that displays when selected and hidden evasion boost that goes into effect immediately in battle.
The stats of certain accessories have been adjusted to provide better boosts.

[b]Quality of Life![/b]
More of the text is highlighted when giving important information to help players. 
A sound will now play and a message will display when encountering a rare enemy.
Certain battle effects have been added and/or adjusted for a better experience.
In response to some feedback, I have begun the process of removing the story related videos from the game and replacing them with pictures. This will allow players to go at their own pace. This is also a workaround for the issue of not being able to pause videos once they start.

[b]Other Information and notes:[/b]

Known Issues: 
I am still working on a fix for pausing battles. The last attempt at it that I tried, the plugin ended up crashing the game entirely. For now, the only workaround I have for you is to click another window to make it your active window so that action will stop (music will still play).
There is a moment in between chapter 6 and 7 where a picture cutscene plays but the pictures slightly flicker. I haven't found the root of the cause for that, as the code is the exact same as the other code that is being used. I may have to rework it or test an alternative - but I will aim to fix that by the next update.

Links to the Short Adventure Wiki and Twitter have been added to the main menu! Just click the logo that is under the main menu choices, and it will open a new web page with your choice!

The wiki is being updated! All of the new main story bosses have already been added to the wiki as of this writing! I will be working on adding the optional bosses and a walkthrough in the upcoming days! I will also be updating the equipment section and adding a tips section for players that don't walk a walkthrough, but find themselves stuck!

Certain skills have been balanced. 
Mishiru, Shara, and Esmeralda all have had their skill power adjusted for every skill. Mishiru and Shara has mostly been buffed while Esmeralda has been nerfed (she could solo the game during testing).  Escarlata's Bullet Punch has been adjusted to deal the correct damage type, while most of her moves have received power adjustments mainly in the form of a boost.

There were countless bug fixes, error corrections etc. that do not need to be placed here. But, I'm telling you so that you know that things are always being worked on to provide the best experience I can for you!

As always, remember, this is a one-man project, so things may take time (I'm a father, full-time government employee)! But, I do strive to get updates out quicker! I felt that 6 months between updates was far too long! I promise to do better!

Thank you for playing Short Adventure! Don't be afraid to reach out to me for help or come by my development streams on Twitch!

- supernerdyguy
